notes: AIRCRAFT_SEPARATION matrix updated 2026-08-21 from the newer draft 'Phu luc Phuong thuc 2 duong CHC song song Da Nang 24.7.2026 Final da giai trinh tiep thu y kien.docx' (vietnam_ats_routes_pack/Du lieu PTB + code/QD duong CHC song song/), which prints its OWN explicit SUPER/HEAVY/MEDIUM/LIGHT wake matrix (5/7/9/10, 5/6/7/8, 5/5/5/7, 5/5/5/5 NM baseline) -- +1NM uniformly vs the previous 4NM-baseline matrix inherited from VVNB/VVTS (version 2.0.0, sourced from the signed QD 2850/QD-CHK 15/12/2022 doc, which did not print its own matrix). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: as of this update, the 24.7.2026 doc is still an unsigned FINAL DRAFT -- its header explicitly reads 'Kem theo Quyet dinh so ___ /QD-CHK ngay ___ /7/2026' with the decision number and exact date left blank, i.e. not yet an officially effective QD. Other numeric changes in that same draft (touchdown-triggered departure release replacing the old 6NM/3-min distance rule, 10s/15s category-split roll timing, 100s runway-vacate limit, 45s crossing-duration limit, 20s go-around cancellation window) were NOT yet applied to this ruleset -- see project memory for the full comparison and the one figure that could not be transcribed (the ATS-surveillance arrival distance for dependent-parallel departure release, sections 4.2.1/4.2.2/4.2.3, is blank/corrupted in the source docx: the wake matrix table appears to have been pasted into that slot by mistake in all 3 places it should appear).

rules.source_section: P45 (new in this draft; not present in the old signed QD 2850/QD-CHK)

conditions.note: Hard safety floor: a departure must never roll before the parallel-runway arrival has touched down, regardless of time-of-day/weather -- true in both the simultaneous-release-OK and the 10-15s-wait regime the draft describes.

rules.source_document: Phu luc Phuong thuc 2 duong CHC song song Da Nang 24.7.2026 Final da giai trinh tiep thu y kien.docx (unsigned final draft as of 2026-08-21)

conditions.note: Conservative-regime check: outside 07h00-17h00 local and/or good-weather conditions (visibility>5km, crosswind<=15kt, no thunderstorm/hazards), the draft requires the departure roll to start at least 10-15s after the parallel touchdown, not simultaneously. Time-of-day/weather are not captured in replay_track.jsonl, so this rule cannot distinguish which regime applies -- it checks the lower bound (10s) as a WARNING, not a hard VIOLATION, since the simultaneous-release regime is legitimately allowed under good conditions this evaluator can't confirm.

rules.source_section: P80, P93 (s4.2.1/4.2.2, conservative regime)

conditions.note: Requires detecting that the arrival went around after touching down, AND correlating with a HOLD/cancel command issued to the parallel-runway departure within 20s of that touchdown. Go-around detection is not yet derived from replay_track.jsonl (would need a distinct go_around event type), and command_log.jsonl is not currently threaded into this evaluator pipeline at all. No evaluator is registered for this kind -- deliberately NOT_EVALUATED rather than approximated with an unrelated proxy metric.
